senses.gloss: (dial. דִּשְׁתָּנָא) f. (Difel, v. דְּ־, denom. of וֶסְתָּא) a menstruous woman.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 110a">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>דיס׳</he> Ms. O. (ed. <cite ref="D01154"><he>דיש׳</he></cite>, Ms. M. <he>דש׳</he>).

Ib. 24ᵇ כמאן קרו פרסאי לנרה דש׳ (Ms. M. אמרי for קרי) on what authority do the Persians call a menstruous woman dishtana (for the usual distana)? Answ. (ref. to Gen. XXXI, 35 as if fr. דוש, cmp. דַּוְושָׁא, having the course of women). [פרסאי does not necessarily refer to the Persian language, as evidenced by the preceding דְּבִיר. Persian dashtân may be borrowed from Aram.—Syr. דשתנא, P. Sm. 958.]
